provenance: Authored by hand for teaching. No molecule here was measured, no activity value is real, and nothing is a design proposal. The labels are produced by the declared rule below and by nothing else.

true_rule.name: carboxylic-acid-required
true_rule.statement: A molecule is active if and only if it contains a carboxylic acid. This is the whole generating rule, and it is known here because the set was constructed rather than measured.
true_rule.why_this_matters: Every claim the model or its explanation makes can be checked against the cause, which is never possible with real activity data.

confounder.name: unsubstituted-furan
confounder.statement: In the training set every active molecule also carries an unsubstituted furan and no inactive molecule does, so the confounder is perfectly correlated with the cause.
confounder.why_it_wins: The furan appears in an identical environment in every active, so its fingerprint bits repeat. The acid appears in a different environment each time, so its credit is spread across many distinct bits. Uniformity, not importance, is what concentrates weight.

threshold.statement: Predictions at or above this value are called active. The value is declared here so that no call below is chosen after seeing a prediction.

analogues.what_they_are: Molecules that break the correlation the training set imposed. They are the experiment that distinguishes the hypothesis an explanation produces from the rule that actually generated the labels.

model.features: Morgan fingerprint, radius 2, 1024 bits, with bit provenance retained so credit can be traced to atoms
model.estimator: ridge regression solved by normal equations, penalty 1.0
model.what_the_model_is_for: To be well fitted and then explained. Nothing here argues that ridge on fingerprints is a good activity model, and its quality is not the subject.
